name: Masked Horrors
summary:
Masked Horrors – A Terrifyingly Silly VR Experience
Run. Climb. Scream. Laugh. Repeat.
Masked Horrors throws you headfirst into a chaotic VR nightmare where the scares are real, but so is the fun.
Inspired by the fast-paced movement of Gorilla Tag and the unpredictable frights of Big Scary, this is a multiplayer horror experience where laughter and terror go hand in hand.
